mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit platelet aggregation and has anticoagulant properties, potentially increasing hyperkalemia risk; concurrent use may elevate serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly in patients taking both agents, especially those with renal dysfunction or on ACE inhibitors/ARBs; counsel on consistent turmeric intake and report symptoms of hyperkalemia.
